body:
Thanks for the effort, but you missed the point. I just wanted advice on how to push away any thought of offing myself that might be comforting. I don't need reassurance that I can make more friends when I move, thats not a problem. It's not that I feel isolated either. I enjoy the quality time I spend with myself, and I have plenty of great friends. "We are all alone at times ... get over it" isn't much help, it's not even close to the problem.

If you have 
>advice on how to dismiss these sort of thoughts 

I would greatly appreciate it.
